cmd:
cd /opt/weather-tg && for f in weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_ai.py weather_tg_issue.py; do curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f -o $f.new && mv $f.new $f; done; python3 -m py_compile weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_ai.py weather_tg_issue.py && echo COMPILED_NAMES; grep -c "Южная окраина" weather_tg_channel.py; K=6532d6454b8aa370768e63d6ba5a832e; for s in IODESA137 IODESA138 IODESA139 IODESS41 IODESS44 IODESS16 IODESS31 IODESS37 IKRASN91; do curl -s "https://api.weather.com/v2/pws/observations/current?stationId=$s&format=json&units=m&apiKey=$K" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
try:
    o=json.load(sys.stdin)[\"observations\"][0]; print(\"$s\", o.get(\"lat\"), o.get(\"lon\"), o.get(\"neighborhood\"))
except Exception as e: print(\"$s ERR\", e)"; done; echo NAMES_DONE
